About Us
Welcome to MP SINGH FOUNDATION
M.P. Singh foundation is a registered charitable trust. It is a non-profit trust, to promote, establish, run, develop and manage institutions and organizations in various fields beneficial to the community without any discrimination of caste, color and creed.
In 2002, M.P. Singh Foundation established Delhi Public School, Meerut under the aegis of the Delhi Public School Society, Meerut, which has two branches now; A) main branch Delhi Public School, Baghpatroad, B) Delhi Public School, Daurala. The school is running solid with 2200 students. Furthering his resolve to spread quality education, Mr. Singh established Delhi Public School in Dehradun in 2008, which has two branches, A) Kalagaon, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun, B) Rajpur road, Dehradun. The school is reaching out to the community not only of Dehradun but also Rishikesh & Mussoorie. The school is benefiting 2300 students as of now, and Shashi Madan Public School, Chandausi.
These schools under the M P Singh Foundation work relentlessly with a mission to develop students of high academic achievement, intellectual curiosity and strong moral character. The Foundation aims at nurturing respectful, responsible and compassionate young adults who are well-prepared to tackle the challenges that lie ahead.
Besides, the Foundation aim to provide a learning environment where children evolve as individuals who are self-motivated and creative, who can ponder, question and reason out logically and work diligently to integrate values with our pedagogical techniques to build a holistic profile and groom to venture into the global arena with an optimistic amalgamation of strength, character and academic excellence.
Open mindedness, a multicultural orientation, independence, a global outlook and multiple intelligences, these are the premium qualities needed today. As a 21st century organization, the schools under the Foundation desire to set an approach to learning that incorporates inquiry, research, analytical thinking and an ethical approach that becomes a lifetime habit.
M P Singh Foundation believes in loving what we do and doing what we all love; whether its academic achievement, athletic discipline, community connection or collaborative projects, our students soar.

M.P. Singh foundation is a registered charitable trust. It is a non-profit trust, to promote, establish, run, develop and manage institutions and organizations in various fields beneficial to the community without any discrimination of caste, color and creed.  
In 2002, M.P. The school is running solid with 2200 students. Furthering his resolve to spread quality education, Mr. Singh established Delhi Public School in Dehradun in 2008, which has two branches, A) Kalagaon, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun, B) Rajpur road, Dehradun. The school is reaching out to the community not only of Dehradun but also Rishikesh & Mussoorie. The school is benefiting 2300 students as of now, and Shashi Madan Public School, Chandausi.

These schools under the M P Singh Foundation work relentlessly with a mission to develop students of high academic achievement, intellectual curiosity and strong moral character. The Foundation aims at nurturing respectful, responsible and compassionate young adults who are well-prepared to tackle the challenges that lie ahead.

Besides, the Foundation aim to provide a learning environment where children evolve as individuals who are self-motivated and creative, who can ponder, question and reason out logically and work diligently to integrate values with our pedagogical techniques to build a holistic profile and groom to venture into the global arena with an optimistic amalgamation of strength, character and academic excellence.

Open mindedness, a multicultural orientation, independence, a global outlook and multiple intelligences, these are the premium qualities needed today. As a 21st century organization, the schools under the Foundation desire to set an approach to learning that incorporates inquiry, research, analytical thinking and an ethical approach that becomes a lifetime habit.

M P Singh Foundation believes in loving what we do and doing what we all love; whether its academic achievement, athletic discipline, community connection or collaborative projects, our students soar.

Life is a sum of your choices-Albert Camus, is vividly brought to life in the story of Shri M. P. Singh ji, a great man and an educationist who continues to live on in the hearts of the lives he touched. Born on the 1st of May, 1947 in village Partapur in Meerut District, Uttar Pradesh in a middle-class agricultural family Mr. M.P. Singh after completing his schooling from his native village pursued his graduation in Mechanical Engineering from Kurukshetra University. He was an F.I.E. and Chartered Engineer.
Mr. Singh started his first small scale unit in Meerut. He went on to become the Chairman of the Cooperative Bank of Meerut District in 1978. In 1983, he set up a medium scale cement unit in Dehradun and was elected the President of the Federation of Mini Cement Plants of India. Thereafter he became a member of the Productivity Council of India. Following his inner voice, Mr. Singh donated land to Sophia School Meerut’ in the village Achronda, near his village to provide education to the deprived villagers.
Mr. M P Singh’s strong urge to give back to society became a reality with the M P Singh Foundation coming into being. The fulfilling feeling of giving back and contributing to society is unparalleled. And, giving back in the form of greatest treasure – ‘Education’ is unparalleled service.
Mr. M.P. Singh
